priority_rule.formula: commercial_intent × economic_value × observed canonical-owner page impressions × ability_to_win × content_gap
priority_rule.scale: Judgment factors remain ordinal 1..5; page impressions are the actual 28-day owner-page observation. The resulting index is prioritization, not ROI, keyword-universe demand or an outcome claim.
priority_rule.unknown_query_demand: Query-universe demand remains UNKNOWN because Consultas.csv exposes only 52/1,201 impressions. No ordinal keyword-demand score or zero is fabricated.
priority_rule.tiny_sample_rule: Clicks, CTR and position are recorded but do not penalize or label conversion failure at these sample sizes.
priority_rule.ordering: controllable=true only; descending realized page-exposure index, then known-factor product, then family_id; cap 5
